title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-11-25 (20).jpg
desc: Apartment building in Kyiv after Russian drone and missile attack in the night and the morning of 25 November 2025. 7 people died in the city and 21 were injured (an article).

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-11-14 (20).jpg
desc: Apartment building in Kyiv after Russian drone and missile attack in the night on 14 November 2025. At least 6 people died in the city and over 30 were injured (an article). In this building, wife of Valery Khodemchuk, Natalia Khodemchuk, was injured and died in a hospital the next day (an article).

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-06-17 (90).jpg
desc: Apartment building in Kyiv after Russian attack on the city with missiles and drones in the night on 17 June 2025. At least 16 people died and more than 130 were injured in Kyiv (an article).

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 20250424 (05).jpg
desc: Destructions in Kyiv due to Russian mass attack on the city by missiles and drones in the night on 24 April 2025. An apartment building was destroyed and a number of other buildings were damaged. 12 people are known to be dead and 90 to be injured.
